name: Cat Hai fish sauce
summary: Nước mắm Cát Hải, also called nước mắm Vạn Vân on the district account, is the sauce a Cát Bà visitor can buy. The story is đảo Cát Hải, the other island. The honey account tells a Cát Bà visitor they can also buy this sauce. It is not a Hải Phòng noodle.
howToEat: Use it as the dipping sauce, or take a bottle home. The account does not build a dish on it. A shop door on Cát Bà is Check on arrival. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: The making is on đảo Cát Hải. Bought from Cát Bà on the honey account. A door on this harbor is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nước mắm Cát Hải — the island sauce
seoDescription: Nước mắm Cát Hải, also called Vạn Vân, is sunned 12 to 24 months, at 15 to 40 degrees of protein. A current price is Check on arrival.
culture: The district account says the smell meets you on đảo Cát Hải, that the Vạn Vân workshop dates from 1916, and that the special-zone list calls it a twentieth-century brand. Protein runs from 15 to 40 degrees. Fish named: cá nhâm, cá nục, cá quẩn, cá mực, cá cơm, mainly cá nhâm. Salted fish is sunned 12 to 24 months. The account says no chemical is used for smell or color.
